system_architecture.description: Custom built 16-layer VGG network (13 Conv2D + 5 MaxPooling2D + 3 Dense) without tf.keras.applications, randomly initialized with He-Normal, lr=1e-4 Adam

stage_1_auditing_and_cleaning.scientific_insight: Val Accuracy dropped from 65.81% to 60.88% after removing 49 leakage pairs. This conclusively proves the baseline suffered from artificial score inflation due to Data Leakage.

stage_2_geometric_and_contrast.scientific_insight: Massive jump: Val Accuracy surged +20.54% (60.88% -> 81.42%) and Test Accuracy surged +28.85% (55.77% -> 84.62%) purely from bounding-box centering and scan background whitening.

stage_3_balanced_augmentation.scientific_insight: Validation accuracy crossed the 90% threshold for the first time while strictly obeying no horizontal flip.

stage_4_max_capacity_target.scientific_insight: Peak performance achieved with 91.21% Validation Accuracy and 80.77% Label Book Test Accuracy. ModelCheckpoint restored best weights at Epoch 13.
